item.title: Russian drone attack kills a father and 3 children in Ukraine while pregnant mother survives
item.description: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — A Russian drone smashed into a home in Ukraine’s northeastern Kharkiv region overnight, killing a father and his three small children, officials said Wednesday. item.title: Dothan City Schools introduces bonuses to retain teachers
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Dothan City Schools announced a new Hiring and Retention Bonus Program Wednesday aimed at attracting and retaining certified teachers at schools that need more educators. The "Teach Where You're Needed Most" initiative will provide bonuses to educators as they continue to teach at schools the district considers to be most critical. [...]
